messages:
ashok: Hey team — want to kick off a small co-launch play for Datadog + OpenTelemetry focused on our Dedicated & Private customers. Goal: a one-command 'integration starter kit' that drops in sampler config, an OTLP exporter example, and a Datadog dashboard JSON so customers can ramp quickly. Thoughts?

maria: Love it. Customers ask for turnkey observability often. Suggest we aim for: 1) repo with k8s & helm quickstart, 2) dashboard + trace sample, 3) docs + short howto video.

greg: +1. I can own the repo scaffolding and CI. Planning a repo under obs-starters. Will open initial PR this week: https://github.com/redwood-inference/obs-starters/pull/42 :rocket:

ashok: Awesome. @greg can you add a sample quantized-model trace so latency spans show up? We should highlight GPU inference span attributes (model_name, seq_len, batch_size).

greg: Yep — I'll add a sample shim that emits spans like:```
host.service:inference -> span:infer.start
attributes: {"model.name":"rw-v1-7b", "device":"A10G", "batch.size":4}
infer.end -> span duration
```

sylvia: I'll draft the joint co-announce copy with Datadog. Need a clear customer benefit line: "deploy quickly, see inference latency, and correlate traces with app requests." Also want a screenshot of the dashboard. @maria can you produce a quick mock?

maria: I can mock a dashboard by tomorrow. Will export a JSON that Datadog can import and we'll include it in the repo under /dashboards/dd-starter.json.

ashok: Ops questions: for Private/VPC installs we must ensure the OTLP endpoint patterns are explicit and we include KMS notes. Let's add a short checklist in README for network config + KMS env.

greg: Adding checklist. For CI, I'll include a simple smoke test that posts a small OTLP batch to a local collector container and verifies spans ingested. Command will be:```
make smoke-test && docker run --rm -p4317:4317 otel/opentelemetry-collector:latest --config configs/collector.yaml
```

marketing-bot: Reminder: co-marketing calendar needs the approved asset 10 days before publish. Please set a target publish date now.

sylvia: Proposed publish window: 2026-04-15 to coincide with a Datadog partner update. That means assets due 2026-04-05.

maria: Ack — dashboard mock ready by 04-01, docs draft by 04-03.

greg: Repo PR opened and CI tests passing by 04-03.

ashok: Roles recap: greg = repo & CI; maria = dashboard + examples; sylvia = co-announcement copy & marketing coord; i'll handle partner technical signoff and MTT (partner technical test) checklist. Anyone else to loop in?

sylvia: Can we loop in sales-ops for enablement slides? I'll add them to the announce thread once copy is close.

ashok: Cool. Next sync: quick check-in on Tuesday 10am PT. If blockers pop up, post here. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
